name: WEC ENERGY GROUP, INC.
moat_justification: Exclusive regulated electric/gas franchises in WI/IL/MI/MN with captive essential-service customers, constructive Wisconsin regulation on most of the rate base, and a $37.5B all-regulated 2026-2030 capital plan (plus a very-large-customer tariff for data-center load) giving visible rate-base compounding — against regulator-capped allowed returns with no pricing power beyond rate cases, proven Illinois disallowance/settlement costs, a debt-plus-equity funded plan that dilutes per-share growth (share count +0.81%/yr), and long-run gas-network electrification and affordability risk.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -3.29 vs 3-yr median 1.24 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.2% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 49.9x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: High-quality regulated Midwest monopoly, moat 6/10 — but at $106.08 its $1.24/share normalized OE yields only a 4.1% weighted IRR (IV@15% $12.48), and even an EPS-based method lands in Tier D; it clears 15% only at ~$12.48 on the OE screen (~$55 on the friendlier EPS basis).
moat_for: Exclusive regulated electric/gas territories in WI/IL/MI/MN — captive essential-service customers
Constructive Wisconsin PSC regulation on most of the rate base, historically high allowed ROE
$37.5B all-regulated 2026-2030 capital plan converts spend into rate base; VLC tariff for data-center load
Execution record: guidance met and 23 consecutive annual dividend increases
moat_against: Returns capped at regulator-set ROE — no pricing power beyond filed rate cases
Illinois regulatory risk is proven: disallowances and rider settlements already realized
Debt-funded plan plus planned equity issuance dilutes per-share growth
Gas network electrification/decarbonization risk and rate-affordability politics
